content: Hey love, how was your day? I was thinking about you all through my shift. It gets lonely out here on the rig sometimes.
Aw, that's sweet of you. My day was alright, just work and the usual. I imagine it's tough out there, being away from everyone.
Yeah, it's not easy, but getting to talk to you is honestly the best part of my day. Ever since we met, it feels like I have something to look forward to again.
That means a lot. I feel the same way. I haven't really connected with anyone like this in a long time.
I want you to know, when I say I care about you, I mean it. When I'm off this rig, my only plan is to finally meet you and start building something real together.
I would love that so much. Sometimes I worry this is too good to be true.
I understand, sweetheart. It's hard to trust people online, but I promise you, my feelings are genuine. I want nothing more than to show you my world when I'm home.
Thank you for saying that. I want to trust you. I really do.
You can, I swear. I'm always honest with you, and I'll always be here for you. Actually, I wanted to talk to you about something important. I'm facing an unexpected situation here.
Oh no, what's going on? Is everything alright?
It's nothing dangerous, just frustrating. The company payroll is delayed due to a technical issue, and I need to pay my satellite communications bill so I can keep talking to you and handle my work.
That sounds stressful. Are you going to be okay?
I'll be okay, but I don't want to lose touch with you, even for a day. If I can't pay the bill, I might not be able to message you for a while, and that would break my heart.
Is there anything I can do to help?
Honestly, I'd never ask if I had any other choice, but would you be able to help me cover the $900 fee? As soon as payroll is sorted, I'll reimburse you, I promise.
That's a lot... I want to help but I need to make sure this is safe. Are you sure everything's legit?
Of course, darling. I understand your concern. I can show you the invoice from the communications provider if you want. I've never lied to you, and I never will. You mean too much to me.
Okay, I trust you. How do I send the money?
Thank you, sweetheart. You can send it via Bitcoin to this wallet address: 1Bx7k9wJ8v9uy3RjK7tF1Wc6. It's the quickest and most reliable way from here.
I've never used Bitcoin before. How do I do that?
No worries, I can walk you through it step by step. Do you have a Coinbase or Binance account? If not, I can help you set one up.
I don't have one yet, but I guess I can try. Is it safe to use?
Absolutely, millions of people use it every day. I'll help you with every step. Once you're set up, you just need to buy the Bitcoin and send it to my wallet address, it's really simple, I promise.
Okay, I'll try to set it up now. Let me know if I'm doing it right.
Thank you, love. I appreciate this more than I can say. When I'm off this rig, taking you out for a beautiful dinner is the first thing I'm doing.
You're welcome. I hope everything gets sorted quickly. I really want to meet you too.
I can't wait. Just let me know if you need help with the app, or if you have any questions. I'm here for you.
Alright, I'll message if I get stuck. Thanks for trusting me and being honest.
Always, my heart. We're a team. This is just a small hurdle before we finally get our happy ending.
